# fw-web

The board's own website (WebUI.h).

## Rules and traps

- The head is the hub pages' `<header class="topbar">` written out by hand:
  mice-ui.js is not in flash (mice_nong near its OTA slot). See docs/web_style.md.
- Shared code may not name a type's variable (`camAsked` is cam-only): talk to
  a type block through an event (`mice-login`) instead.
